purpose: Complete 27-Check acceptance ledger; not a combinatorial UI-state inventory or release certification.
splitting_rules: Preserve each full Check paragraph verbatim. Sentence indexes are reproducible punctuation boundaries followed by an uppercase letter; decimal money values are not boundaries.
Keep setup-only sentences with their required outcome. Preserve inherited setup across consecutive scenario sentences; a source quote is not a standalone precondition reset.

Split distinct explicit actions/branches when they can independently pass or fail (share/empty cart/offline, token states, cancel/retry, invalidation causes). Reuse exact source sentences and name the variant rather than fabricate new text.

Split independent outcomes in S12 and S25. Keep tightly coupled invariant field lists together, such as retained free capabilities, privacy exclusions, or prohibited quote side effects; every listed part is required before proof.
Do not multiply role, localization, theme, device, accessibility or data combinations. A named variant in a related test may limit acceptance (S06 Reduce Motion), but does not create a new contract.

A proven clause needs an inspected assertion matching the outcome and a per-selector Passed node tied to exact hashed frozen source. Related test names/passing buckets are insufficient. Model-only proof is explicitly scoped.

Contradicted-current denotes a retained failing acceptance journey in the latest mapped ordinary core run, not necessarily a causally established product logic defect. No active diagnostic outcome is inferred.

Indirect-or-unmapped includes partial coverage, source-only tests and results whose exact assertions were not completely bound in this bounded review; it does not mean unimplemented, untested, or broken.
Owner-or-human-external is reserved for a clause whose remaining acceptance directly needs human/device/external action; model proof is retained separately when meaningful.
